subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should an oversized existing `BOOT.md` fail the boot check visibly, or be silently classified as empty and skipped?
rationale: Both outcomes bound memory safely, but they differ in whether existing startup instructions can disappear without an operator-visible failure; repository policy treats that fallback and compatibility choice as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Fail visibly on oversize
options.body: Preserve the bounded read but return the established failed outcome with a clear size-limit diagnostic so operators know startup instructions did not run.

options.title: Accept silent skip
options.body: Keep the current skipped-empty behavior and explicitly own the compatibility tradeoff for oversized existing files.

recommendation.title: Fail visibly on oversize
recommendation.body: Preserve the bounded read but return the established failed outcome with a clear size-limit diagnostic so operators know startup instructions did not run.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged per-agent boot work makes this the strongest available history-based owner for `BOOT.md` execution semantics.
